source.title: Intrinsically Motivated Goal Exploration Processes with Automatic Curriculum Learning

confidence_rationale: Establishes learning-progress as a distinct, competence-directed intrinsic drive (abandons both mastered AND unlearnable regions -- escapes the noisy-TV trap novelty falls into). Lightest build (a goal-selection bookkeeping layer). Framework/robotics evidence, not a MiniGrid floor number.
failure_signatures: A plain novelty/count bonus keeps rewarding irreducible-noise regions (noisy-TV); learning-progress instead tracks reducible error and abandons unlearnable regions -- the property novelty lacks.

mapping.source_claim_statement: An agent self-generates parameterized goals and selects which to pursue by maximizing learning progress (empirical improvement in achieving goals from a region), producing an automatic curriculum from easy/high-progress to harder goals, reusing information across goals (hindsight-like).
mapping.ree_translation: Learning-progress is the competence-directed drive that separates this class from REE's density-directed curiosity substrate; it is the goal-selection rule that makes a curriculum abandon both mastered and unlearnable regions, targeting exactly the frontier where competence is gainable.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Framework + robotic-arm/multi-goal experiments, not a MiniGrid floor->competent benchmark; it corroborates the mechanism class and the learning-progress-vs-novelty distinction more than it supplies a head-to-head number.
mapping.source_context: Developmental robotics / multi-goal exploration; parameterized goal spaces, robotic-arm and simulated tasks.

confidence_components.notes: Load-bearing for the 'learning-progress != novelty' composition argument; lightest-weight build of the curriculum class.
